# Data Health  
[⌂ HOME](/d/dpp-home) · [SALES](/d/dpp-sales) · CATALOG · ADS · [INVENTORY](/d/dpp-inventory) · FINANCE · TRAJECTORY · **DATA HEALTH**  
*This page answers: are the feeds current, complete enough to use, and failing anywhere?*

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM core.amazon_order WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';
SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM core.financial_transaction;
SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM core.sales_traffic_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';
SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM core.asin_sales_traffic_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';
SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM mart.inventory_current WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8';
SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM ops.data_health WHERE latest_status<>'success';

SELECT source AS "Source",job_name AS "Job",latest_status AS "Status",records_read AS "Read",records_written AS "Written",to_char(last_finished_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Finished",date_trunc('second',age)::text AS "Age",COALESCE(error_message,'') AS "Error" FROM ops.data_health ORDER BY last_started_at DESC;
SELECT source AS "Source",job_name AS "Job",cursor_name AS "Cursor",cursor_value AS "Value",to_char(updated_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Updated" FROM ops.ingestion_cursor ORDER BY updated_at DESC;

SELECT 'Orders' AS "Dataset",min(created_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::text AS "First",max(created_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::text AS "Latest",count(*)::bigint AS "Rows" FROM core.amazon_order UNION ALL SELECT 'Finances',min(posted_date AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::text,max(posted_date AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::text,count(*)::bigint FROM core.financial_transaction UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales & Traffic',min(business_date)::text,max(business_date)::text,count(*)::bigint FROM core.sales_traffic_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'ASIN Traffic',min(business_date)::text,max(business_date)::text,count(*)::bigint FROM core.asin_sales_traffic_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'Inventory',min(snapshot_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::text,max(snapshot_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::text,count(*)::bigint FROM core.inventory_snapshot;

SELECT source AS "Source",resource_type AS "Resource",count(*)::bigint AS "Payloads",to_char(max(fetched_at),'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Latest Fetch" FROM raw.api_payload GROUP BY source,resource_type ORDER BY max(fetched_at) DESC;
